task03_independent.hint: All eight points are read from one curve that was integrated from one reference temperature.

task03_fit_A.hint: A = γ̄ − B T̄, in J/m².

task03_fit_B.hint: B = Σ(T − T̄)(γ − γ̄) / Σ(T − T̄)², in J/(m² K); γ falls with T.

task03_max_residual.hint: Residual = fit minus reading at each of the eight temperatures; take the largest size, in J/m².

task03_minus_B_mJ.hint: Change the sign of B, then 1 J = 1000 mJ.

task03_V_m.hint: N_Av a³ / 4 with a in metres.

task03_A_GB.hint: 3 V_m / d: each cube face is shared by two grains.

task03_rho.hint: Two {111} planes of 4/(√3 a²) atoms per m², divided by N_Av.

task03_n_b.hint: The boundary atoms come out of the one mole.

task03_A_six_faces.hint: Without sharing, every face is counted once per grain: 6 V_m / d.

task03_total_wrong.hint: One mole in the bulk plus the boundary atoms on top.

task03_epsilon_500.hint: γ divided by ρ: J/m² over mol sites/m².

task03_excess_500.hint: n_s ε, which equals A_GB γ.

task03_excess_zero.hint: With no offset every Ni atom has the same molar energy.

task03_validates.hint: The recovery follows from n_b + n_s = 1; what does it test?
